judgments.reason: PhysioNet record of the CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database; abstract matches this dataset (Children's Hospital Boston, pediatric intractable seizures, anti-seizure medication withdrawal), so it is another deposit of the same data.
MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used for converting the data, not a paper describing the CHB-MIT dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
